paper: MASS: Multi-agent simulation scaling for portfolio construction
headline_strategy: Simulate 16 investor types with 32 LLM agents each, give every agent a 20-stock candidate pool and five selections, aggregate heterogeneous decisions with learned type-distribution weights and alpha=0.5, optimize that distribution by simulated annealing, and hold the weekly top 20% signals with 0.1% round-trip cost
paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable because the release contains distribution state but no agent decisions, dated signals, U.S. input panel, portfolio, or return path
missing_headline_objects: all per-agent prompts, multimodal inputs, decisions and candidate-pool assignments
dated aggregated signals and security rankings
Nasdaq-100/S&P-500 and other paper input panels, point-in-time memberships, and news
paper hyperparameter execution, run seeds, random draws, and metric horizon
weekly portfolio/backtest/cost code, baseline outputs, timing logs and API accounting
holdings, returns, risk-free rate, NAV paths and table/figure arrays
source_conflicts: Active source uses simulated-annealing temperature 0.5 and 20 iterations rather than paper values 40 and 100.
Active source resamples agent candidate pools daily although the main paper treats pools as static and daily updating as an ablation.
Source generates one strategy per agent/day rather than one per investor type/day.
Entrypoint has empty root constants, broken literal paths, missing data modules, and placeholder two-byte news files.
The paper does not identify which released 1/5/10-day label horizon produced its main table.

rejected_substitutes.reason: The 766 numeric claims and five figures expose no dated decisions, rankings, holdings, or returns.

result_policy: No distribution-only inference, label replay, synthetic dry run, arbitrary JKP decision tensor, or displayed output is entered as a MASS return. Its positive results remain unresolved rather than classified as false or as JKP underperformance.
